note: Curated public webcams for the place popup (F-26). One entry per camera. 'place' is the id of an entry in 'places'; a search result or capital shows the cameras of the nearest place within its radius r (km) in the same country. format: live | timelapse | image. player: youtube (embed is a youtube-nocookie.com URL), iframe (official embed URL of the operator) or image (latest still image); no player means the operator only offers a link, so the popup shows 'Watch on provider site'. 'check' records how the camera was checked; scripts/check-webcams.mjs re-checks every player in the Data & Deploy Action and writes data/live/webcams-status.json.
